An Origins Project Dialogue with Mariette DiChristina
As the eighth Editor-in-Chief of Scientific American, and the first woman to hold the position in
170 years, Mariette DiChristina is a true science enthusiast and journalist with more than 20
years of experience. She is also the Origins Project's esteemed guest at the upcoming
Trailblazing for Science: An Evening with Mariette DiChristina. We invite you to meet and learn
more about Mariette in our latest blog_post.
Be sure to get your tickets and join us on Friday, April 22 at Herberger Theater Center for an
evening with Mariette DiChristina and Lawrence Krauss as they discuss the role of science in our
life and how to better fuse the relationship between science and journalism in the digital age.

Upcoming cruise Announcement
From the Galapagos Islands to Antarctica the Origins Project has offered curious adventurers
and science enthusiasts the opportunity to explore some of the world's greatest treasures.
Aboard these cruises, Lawrence Krauss has led explorers on trips throughout space and time
with a number of lectures and talks. Sound intriguing? Follow us on Facebook and Twitter and be
on the lookout for information regarding an upcoming Origins Project cruise. You won't want to
miss it!
